card.name: Noun right after "the following"
card.fires_on: The noun right after "the following" (doses, drugs, organization, situations, day), usually just before a colon or a list. Also fires on a few other nouns that open a heading or list, like "Human capital" and "Please Note".

modes.label: After "following"
modes.description: A noun that follows "the following" and introduces a list or a condition.
modes.example: 4 CONTRAINDICATIONS Sulfamethoxazole and Trimethoprim Injection is contraindicated in the following<< situations>>: Known hypersensitivity to trimethop

modes.label: Heading-like nouns
modes.description: A noun at the start of a title or a notice, often before a colon.
modes.example: Please<< Note>>: By clicking a link to any resource
